(1) t′时刻喷出来的水滴在 $t _ { 0 }$ 时刻的位置为:

$$
r \left( t ^ { \prime } \right) = u \left( t _ { 0 } - t ^ { \prime } \right)
$$

$$
\theta \left( t ^ { \prime } \right) = \theta _ { 0 } \sin \omega _ { 0 } t ^ { \prime }\tag{1}
$$

消去参量 $t ^ { \prime } ,$ 得到:

$$
\theta \left( r \right) = \theta _ { 0 } \sin \omega _ { 0 } \left( t _ { 0 } - \frac { r } { u } \right)\tag{2}
$$

其中自变量γ的范围为:

$$
0 \leq r \leq u t_{0}\tag{3}
$$

(2) t'时刻喷出来的水滴在 $t _ { 0 }$ 时刻的位置为 $(r,\theta)$ ，则由余弦定理可得:

![](data/images/2024-e0beb6cc/2024-启慧研习院-答案-力+热-4.jpg)

$$
\begin{aligned} &r\left(t^{\prime}\right)=\sqrt{v^{2}t_{0}^{2}+u^{2}\left(t_{0}-t^{\prime}\right)^{2}+2vut_{0}\left(t_{0}-t^{\prime}\right)\cos\theta^{\prime}}\\ &\tan\theta=\frac{u\left(t_{0}-t^{\prime}\right)\sin\theta^{\prime}}{vt_{0}+u\left(t_{0}-t^{\prime}\right)\cos\theta^{\prime}}\\ \end{aligned}\tag{4}
$$

其中 $\theta ^ { \prime }$ 为喷头静止系中的出射角:

$$
\theta ^ { \prime } \left( t ^ { \prime } \right) = \theta _ { 0 } \sin \omega _ { 0 } t ^ { \prime }\tag{5}
$$

代入（5）得轨迹的参数方程:

$$
\begin{aligned}r\left(t^{\prime}\right) &= \sqrt{v^{2}t_{0}^{2} + u^{2}\left(t_{0} - t^{\prime}\right)^{2} + 2vut_{0}\left(t_{0} - t^{\prime}\right)\cos\left(\theta_{0}\sin\omega_{0}t^{\prime}\right)} \\\theta\left(t^{\prime}\right) &= \arctan\frac{u\left(t_{0} - t^{\prime}\right)\sin\left(\theta_{0}\sin\omega_{0}t^{\prime}\right)}{vt_{0} + u\left(t_{0} - t^{\prime}\right)\cos\left(\theta_{0}\sin\omega_{0}t^{\prime}\right)}\end{aligned}\tag{6}
$$

(3)当喷头静止时，轴上探测器探测到水的频率为:

$$
f_{0} = \frac{\omega_{0}}{\pi}\tag{7}
$$

由运动学关系，有:

$$
f_{recive} = \frac{u + v}{u} \frac{\omega_0}{\pi}\tag{8}
$$

(4)同（2)问，将 $\theta ^ { \prime }$ 替换为 $\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta'$ 即可:

![](data/images/2024-e0beb6cc/2024-启慧研习院-答案-力+热-5.jpg)

$$
r\left(t^{\prime}\right)=\sqrt{v^{2}t_{0}^{2}+u^{2}\left(t_{0}-t^{\prime}\right)^{2}+2vut_{0}\left(t_{0}-t^{\prime}\right)\sin\left(\theta_{0}\sin\omega_{0}t^{\prime}\right)}\tag{9}
$$

(5）本问中，为简便，将θ正方向反向，易见不影响结果。在喷头参考系中研究问题。先求一个微分备用:

$$
\mathrm{d}\theta = (\omega_{0}\theta_{0}\cos\omega_{0}t)\mathrm{d}t \Rightarrow \mathrm{d}t = \frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\omega_{0}\theta_{0}\cos\omega_{0}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\omega_{0}\sqrt{\theta_{0}^{2} - \theta^{2}}}\tag{10}
$$

![](data/images/2024-e0beb6cc/2024-启慧研习院-答案-力+热-6.jpg)

如图，设喷头于 $t ^ { \prime }$ 时刻以倾角 $\theta$ 发出的水于t时刻到达探测器，下一次是 $t' + \Delta t'$ 时刻以倾角 $\theta + \Delta \theta$发出的水于 $t + \Delta t$ 时刻到达探测器。注意到 $\omega _ { 0 } b \gg v$ ，可得 $v \frac { 2 \pi } { \omega _ { 0 } } \ll b ,$ 因此 $\Delta \theta$ 为小量。由小量近似可得

$$
\Delta \theta = \frac{v \Delta t \cos \theta}{b / \cos \theta} = \frac{v \Delta t \cos^2 \theta}{b}\tag{11}
$$

从题图可以看出，相邻两次喷水时，喷头并非是从θ向下连续运动至 $\boldsymbol{\theta} + \Delta \boldsymbol{\theta}$ ，必然经过转折，有两种情况:先向下再向上（图中标1），或先向上再向下（图中标2）。联合（10）式可得喷水时间差:

·情况 1:

$$
\Delta t_{1}^{\prime}=\frac{\pi-2\arcsin\frac{\theta}{\theta_{0}}}{\omega_{0}}-\frac{\Delta\theta}{\omega_{0}\sqrt{\theta_{0}^{2}-\theta^{2}}}\tag{12}
$$

·情况 $2 ;$

$$
\Delta t_{1}^{\prime}=\frac{\pi+2\arcsin\frac{\theta}{\theta_{0}}}{\omega_{0}}+\frac{\Delta\theta}{\omega_{0}\sqrt{\theta_{0}^{2}-\theta^{2}}}\tag{13}
$$

另，两次喷水所经距离差为 $v \Delta t \sin \theta$ ，根据运动学关系得:

$$
\Delta t' = \left(1 - \frac{v \sin \theta}{u}\right) \Delta t\tag{14}
$$

联立（11）～（14）得

$$
\Delta t_{1}=\frac{\pi - 2\arcsin\frac{\theta}{\theta_{0}}}{\omega_{0}}\cdot \left(1 - \frac{v}{u}\sin\theta + \frac{v}{\omega_{0}b}\frac{\cos^{2}\theta}{\sqrt{\theta_{0}^{2} - \theta^{2}}}\right)^{- 1}\tag{15}
$$

$$
\Delta t_{2}=\frac{\pi + 2\arcsin\frac{\theta}{\theta_{0}}}{\omega_{0}}\cdot \left(1 - \frac{v}{u}\sin\theta - \frac{v}{\omega_{0}b}\frac{\cos^{2}\theta}{\sqrt{\theta_{0}^{2} - \theta^{2}}}\right)^{- 1}\tag{16}
$$

探测到的平均频率为

$$
f = \frac{2}{\Delta t_{1} + \Delta t_{2}}\tag{17}
$$

代入（15）（16），取 $v / ( \omega _ { 0 } b )$ 的一阶近似，得到

$$
f = \left( 1 - \frac{v}{u} \sin \theta \right) \frac{\omega_0}{\pi} - \left( \frac{\cos^2 \theta \arcsin \frac{\theta}{\theta_0}}{\pi^2 \sqrt{\theta_0^2 - \theta^2}} \right) \frac{v}{b}\tag{18}
$$
